schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sites (site TEXT PRIMARY KEY, enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0, scope TEXT DEFAULT '', locked INTEGER DEFAULT 0, fence INTEGER DEFAULT 0,note TEXT DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS books (site TEXT, thread TEXT, key TEXT, title TEXT, touched INTEGER, closed INTEGER DEFAULT 0, anchor TEXT DEFAULT '', live TEXT DEFAULT '', livebytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0, visible TEXT DEFAULT '', building TEXT DEFAULT '', layout TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(site,thread))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (site TEXT, thread TEXT, run TEXT PRIMARY KEY, edge TEXT DEFAULT '', stamp INTEGER DEFAULT 0, complete INTEGER DEFAULT 0, bytes INTEGER DEFAULT 0, seq INTEGER DEFAULT 0, mark TEXT, head TEXT, oldest TEXT DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunks (run TEXT, seq INTEGER, body TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(run,seq))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed (site TEXT, key TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(site,key))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS runs_site ON runs(site,thread)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reading_pages (run TEXT PRIMARY KEY, site TEXT, thread TEXT, tail INTEGER, older INTEGER, newer INTEGER, first TEXT, last TEXT)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reading_thread ON reading_pages(site,thread)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reading_positions (run TEXT, turn TEXT, item TEXT, seq INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(run,turn,item,seq))

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS forget_reading_run AFTER DELETE ON runs BEGIN DELETE FROM reading_positions WHERE run=OLD.run; DELETE FROM reading_pages WHERE run=OLD.run; DELETE FROM chunks WHERE run=OLD.run; END
register: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO sites(site) VALUES(:site)
status: ?SELECT enabled, locked, fence,note,CASE WHEN locked THEN '' ELSE scope END AS scope FROM sites WHERE site=:site
auth: !SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND length(:scope)=64
DELETE FROM books WHERE site=:site AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND scope<>:scope)
DELETE FROM removed WHERE site=:site AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND scope<>:scope)
note: UPDATE sites SET note=:note WHERE site=:site AND :note IN ('','unsupported','paused') AND note<>:note
revoke: !SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND scope=:scope
UPDATE sites SET locked=1,scope='',fence=fence+1 WHERE site=:site
lock: UPDATE sites SET locked=1,fence=fence+1 WHERE site=:site AND locked=0
reauthorize: UPDATE sites SET scope='',locked=1,fence=fence+1 WHERE site=:site AND (scope<>'' OR NOT locked)
enable: UPDATE sites SET enabled=CAST(:enable AS INTEGER),fence=fence+1 WHERE site=:site
allow: DELETE FROM removed WHERE site=:site AND key=:key
capture: ?SELECT fence FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND enabled AND NOT locked AND scope=:scope AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM removed WHERE site=:site AND key=:key)
checkpoint: UPDATE books SET closed=0 WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread AND closed AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND enabled AND NOT locked AND scope=:scope AND fence=CAST(:fence AS INTEGER))

?SELECT r.run,r.edge,r.seq,r.complete,r.oldest,b.key FROM books b JOIN sites s USING(site) JOIN runs r ON r.run=CASE WHEN b.building<>'' THEN b.building ELSE b.visible END WHERE b.site=:site AND b.thread=:thread AND s.enabled AND NOT s.locked AND s.scope=:scope AND r.mark=:mark AND r.head=:head
start: !SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND enabled AND NOT locked AND scope=:scope AND fence=CAST(:fence AS INTEGER) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM removed WHERE site=:site AND key=:key)
!SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM books WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread) OR ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE site=:site)<1000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books)<5000)
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO books(site,thread,key,title,touched) VALUES(:site,:thread,:key,:title,:now)
UPDATE books SET building=:run,title=:title,closed=0 WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread
write: !SELECT 1 WHERE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bytes) FROM runs WHERE site=:site),0)+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(livebytes) FROM books WHERE site=:site),0)+length(CAST(:body AS BLOB))<=67108864 AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bytes) FROM runs),0)+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(livebytes) FROM books),0)+length(CAST(:body AS BLOB))<=201326592
!SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE run=:run AND seq=CAST(:seq AS INTEGER) AND bytes+length(CAST(:body AS BLOB))<=16777216
UPDATE runs SET bytes=bytes+length(CAST(:body AS BLOB)),seq=seq+1,edge=:edge,oldest=:oldest WHERE run=:run

UPDATE books SET visible=:run WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread AND (visible='' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runs old JOIN runs fresh ON fresh.run=:run WHERE old.run=books.visible AND NOT old.complete AND fresh.seq>=old.seq))
finish: UPDATE runs SET complete=1,oldest='' WHERE run=:run
UPDATE books SET visible=:run,building='',live='',livebytes=0 WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread
writer: !SELECT 1 FROM sites JOIN books USING(site) WHERE site=:site AND enabled AND NOT locked AND scope=:scope AND fence=CAST(:fence AS INTEGER) AND thread=:thread AND building=:run
windowlive: !SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND scope=:scope AND fence=CAST(:fence AS INTEGER) AND enabled AND NOT locked
live: !SELECT 1 WHERE length(CAST(:body AS BLOB))<524288 AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bytes) FROM runs WHERE site=:site),0)+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(livebytes) FROM books WHERE site=:site AND thread<>:thread),0)+length(CAST(:body AS BLOB))<=67108864 AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bytes) FROM runs),0)+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(livebytes) FROM books WHERE site<>:site OR thread<>:thread),0)+length(CAST(:body AS BLOB))<=201326592

UPDATE books SET live=:body,livebytes=length(CAST(:body AS BLOB)) WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread AND NOT closed AND :run IN (building,visible) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND enabled AND NOT locked AND scope=:scope AND fence=CAST(:fence AS INTEGER))
bookmark: UPDATE books SET anchor=:anchor,touched=:now WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND NOT locked)
touch: UPDATE books SET touched=:now WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread
closed: UPDATE books SET closed=CASE WHEN closed=0 THEN 1 ELSE closed END,building='' WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread
lifecycle: UPDATE books SET closed=CASE :reason WHEN 'deleted' THEN 4 WHEN 'archived' THEN 3 WHEN 'closed' THEN CASE WHEN closed IN (3,4) THEN closed ELSE 2 END ELSE 0 END,building='' WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread AND :reason IN ('deleted','archived','closed','opened','unarchived') AND (closed<>4 OR :reason IN ('opened','unarchived')) AND (closed<>0 OR :reason NOT IN ('opened','unarchived')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sites WHERE site=:site AND NOT locked AND scope=:scope AND length(:scope)=64)
checklock: UPDATE sites SET locked=1,fence=fence+1 WHERE site=:site AND scope=:scope AND fence=CAST(:fence AS INTEGER) AND NOT locked
revert: DELETE FROM books WHERE site=:site AND thread=:thread
UPDATE sites SET fence=fence+1 WHERE site=:site
list: ?SELECT b.thread,b.key,b.title,b.touched,b.closed,r.complete,r.stamp,r.bytes+b.livebytes AS bytes FROM books b JOIN sites s USING(site) JOIN runs r ON r.run=b.visible WHERE b.site=:site AND NOT s.locked ORDER BY b.touched DESC
book: ?SELECT b.thread,b.title,b.anchor,b.live,r.run,r.edge,r.seq,r.bytes,r.complete,r.stamp FROM books b JOIN sites s USING(site) JOIN runs r ON r.run=b.visible WHERE b.site=:site AND b.thread=:thread AND NOT s.locked
chunk: ?SELECT c.body FROM chunks c JOIN books b ON b.visible=c.run JOIN sites s USING(site) WHERE b.site=:site AND b.thread=:thread AND NOT s.locked AND c.run=:run AND c.seq=CAST(:seq AS INTEGER)
candidates: ?SELECT b.key || '.' || b.touched || '.' || b.closed || '.' || (b.thread=:reading) AS choice, s.fence,s.locked,(b.thread=:reading) AS reading, CASE WHEN s.locked THEN '' ELSE b.thread END AS thread, CASE WHEN s.locked THEN '' ELSE b.title END AS title, b.touched,b.closed,COALESCE(v.complete,-1) AS complete, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(bytes) FROM runs r WHERE r.site=b.site AND r.thread=b.thread),0)+b.livebytes AS bytes FROM books b JOIN sites s USING(site) LEFT JOIN runs v ON v.run=b.visible WHERE b.site=:site AND (:mode='all' OR (:mode='review' AND b.thread<>:reading) OR (:mode='old' AND b.thread<>:reading AND (b.closed OR b.touched<=CAST(:before AS INTEGER)))) ORDER BY b.touched,b.key
cleanselected: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO removed SELECT b.site,b.key FROM books b JOIN sites s USING(site) WHERE b.site=:site AND s.fence=CAST(:fence AS INTEGER) AND s.locked=CAST(:locked AS INTEGER) AND instr(:choices, ',' || b.key || '.' || b.touched || '.' || b.closed || '.' || (b.thread=:reading) || ',')>0 AND (:mode='all' OR (:mode='review' AND b.thread<>:reading) OR (:mode='old' AND b.thread<>:reading AND (b.closed OR b.touched<=CAST(:before AS INTEGER))))
DELETE FROM books WHERE site=:site AND key IN (SELECT key FROM removed WHERE site=:site) AND instr(:choices, ',' || key || '.')>0
UPDATE sites SET fence=fence+1 WHERE site=:site AND changes()>0
sweep: DELETE FROM runs WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM books b WHERE b.site=runs.site AND b.thread=runs.thread AND (b.visible=runs.run OR b.building=runs.run)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reading_pages p JOIN books b ON b.site=p.site AND b.thread=p.thread WHERE p.run=runs.run)
DELETE FROM chunks WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runs WHERE runs.run=chunks.run)
